text:
What worked: Nothing could be tested today. The company paper result was Rs 0 because NSE and BSE were shut for Guru Nanak Jayanti.

What did not: The one trade, a NIFTY long straddle for 1 Dec, was marked VOID because NFO was closed and it was priced on the last session's frozen quotes, so it could never have filled. The COO notes still flag no edge so far for the Scalping and Crypto desks, though paper results are not proof of an edge.

What I am changing tomorrow: Trust no signal or trade created on a holiday, and treat today's filings as unconfirmed until prices move on a trading day.

Watch tomorrow: How Indian banks and metals open after Monday's sharp fall, whether the Nvidia-led rebound carries into Indian shares, and Tata Sons' board meeting on November 30.
